  @Override
  public double[] normalizedToUndistortedNormalized(double x, double y) {
    int denormalizedX = (int) (x * pixelWidth());
    int denormalizedY = (int) (y * pixelHeight());
    return pixelToUndistortedNormalized(denormalizedX, denormalizedY);
  }

  @Override
  public double[] pixelToUndistortedNormalized(int x, int y) {
    return map[Util.limit(x, 0, pixelWidth() - 1)][Util.limit(y, 0, pixelHeight() - 1)];
  }

  @Override
  public int pixelWidth() {
    return 640;
  }

  @Override
  public int pixelHeight() {
    return 480;
  }
